messages.subject: [Diagnosismed-list] Notice of appearance in Court #000473933
messages.body_plain:
Notice to Appear,

This is to inform you to appear in the Court on the March 07 for your case hearing.
Please, do not forget to bring all the documents related to the case.
Note: The case will be heard by the judge in your absence if you do not come.

You can find the Court Notice is in the attachment.

Sincerely,
Harold Cash,
Court Secretary.
